units.name: api.service
units.content:
[Unit]
Description=Example HTTP API
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target database.service
[Service]
User=api
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/api-server --listen 127.0.0.1:8080
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
UMask=0077
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

units.name: database.service
units.content:
[Unit]
Description=Example database service
[Service]
DynamicUser=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/db-server --socket /run/db/db.sock
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
UMask=0077
